notices.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer - Video Review
notices.contentSnippet: After over two decades away from the racing game genre, Star Wars returns in a big way with Star Wars: Galactic Racer. Bringing the hard-to-put-down gameplay structure of the roguelite genre to a galaxy far, far away, Star Wars: Galactic Racer is brought to life by a new team made up of veterans that worked on the Burnout and Need for Speed franchises. Regardless of if you're a podracing fan, a Burnout fanatic, or love that "one more run" feeling, this is a new must-play title for 2026.
